standard_prerequisites.name: For any complexes K, L and I there is a canonical identity of Hom complexes Hom(K, Hom(L, I)) = Hom(Tot(K tensor L), I)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the termwise adjunction underlying the derived one.

core_obligations: Choose a K-injective complex I representing M and a K-flat complex L representing L (proof lines 18693-18695). For any complex K of R-modules the compose lemma gives the identity of Hom complexes Hom(K, Hom(L, I)) = Hom(Tot(K tensor L), I) (proof lines 18696-18702). Since RHom_R(L, M) is represented by Hom(L, I) with I K-injective, the left hand side RHom_R(K, RHom_R(L, M)) is represented by Hom(K, Hom(L, I)); the right hand side is represented by Hom(Tot(K tensor L), I) because Tot(K tensor L) represents K tensor_R^L L and I is K-injective; the identity of Hom complexes therefore gives the canonical isomorphism, functorial in K, L, M, and taking H^0 recovers the adjunction formula (proof lines 18702-18704).
proof_roadmap: Choose the K-injective and K-flat representatives (proof lines 18693-18695).
Apply the termwise adjunction and identify both sides in D(R) (proof lines 18696-18704).
difficulty_reason: 14 行、导出内积邻接：取 M 的 K-内射代表 I、L 的 K-平坦代表 L•；compose 引理给逐项恒等式 Hom(K•,Hom(L•,I•)) = Hom(Tot(K•⊗L•),I•)；左端 RHom(K,RHom(L,M)) 由 Hom(K,Hom(L,I)) 代表，右端由 Tot(K⊗L)（代表导出张量积）到 I 的 Hom 代表，故得典范同构、函子性地依赖 K,L,M，取 H^0 即回到邻接公式。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
